locations.name: The Sculpture Garden
locations.atmosphere: Every surface is covered in thin scratches — all at exactly eye height.
hazards: unstable lighting — the dark comes without warning

locations.name: Quarantine Ring
locations.atmosphere: The temperature drops sharply. Your breath fogs. Something in the dark breathes with you.
hazards: residual temporal discharge (sanity drains near the walls)
biohazard mist (health drain without a filter)

locations.name: Memory Vault
locations.atmosphere: Dust hangs motionless in the air, refusing to settle, as if time here has stopped.
hazards: mimic zones: voices here are not who they claim to be

dialogue: "I counted the screams last night. There were more than there are of us."
"The Heart isn't the source. It's the wound. Something else did the cutting."
"The doors only lock from the inside. Think about what that means."
"You shouldn't have come back here. It remembers you now."
alienBehavior: K'Thaal update: has learned the locker routes; hiding spots shift value.
storyBranch: A survivor offers you a working radio — if you'll retrieve a locket from the Flooded Sublevel.
